title: Grain and shoot Zn accumulation in winter wheat affected by nitrogen management
authors: Xue YF, Yue SC, Zhang YQ, Cui ZL, Chen XP, Yang FC, Cakmak I, McGrath SP, Zhang FS, Zou CQ
notes: This paper studies the effect of nitrogen (N) management on Zn accumulation in winter wheat. ALL plots received 30 kg/ha ZnSO4.7H2O as basal fertilizer. There is NO no-Zn control treatment. The experimental variable is N application rate (0, ~99/82.5, ~198/195, ~297/292.5 kg N/ha). Therefore, NO Zn treatment vs. no-Zn control comparisons can be extracted for the Hui 2023 meta-analysis.
